quests.question: Convert to reported speech (unit 4): He said, 'I am ready.'
options: He said that he was ready.
He said that he is ready.
He said that I was ready.
quests.correctAnswer: He said that he was ready.
quests.sentence: He said, 'I am ready.'
quests.hint: Remember to shift the tense backward (e.g., 'am' becomes 'was'). (Log 4 calibration)
quests.explanation: In reported speech, we usually move the tense one step back into the past. [Verified in calibration unit 4].

quests.question: Convert to reported speech (unit 4): She noted, 'I may come to the party.'

quests.correctAnswer: She noted that she might come to the party.
